chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abd Allah and al-Himyari, all together, narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu ‘Abd Allah (عليه السلام), who said:

Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir was taken in death when he was fifty-seven years old, in the year one hundred and fourteen. He lived for nineteen years and two months after Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليهما السلام).

key_terms.عَامِ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and fourteen AH
key_terms.قُبِضَ: was taken in death; passed away
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرُ: Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (عليه السلام)

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (عليه السلام) pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This hadith records the passing of Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (عليه السلام), stating his age at death and the year in which he passed away. It also specifies the length of time he lived after Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليهما السلام), making it an important biographical report in the chronology of the Imams (عليهم السلام).

en.sarwar: 6. Sa‘d. ibn ‘Abdallah and al-Himyari all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother, ali ibn Mhaziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah who has said the following.
“Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir passed away at the age of fifty seven, in the year one hundred fourteen AH. He lived for nineteen years and two months after Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.).”
